subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should OpenClaw expose a TUI send/newline keybinding preference, or should this issue be narrowed to documenting the existing pi-tui Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, and backslash-Enter behavior?
rationale: Current main already has dependency-backed multiline entry, but the requested configurable Enter/Ctrl+Enter/Shift+Enter behavior creates a new config or CLI surface and user-default decision that repository policy requires maintainer intent for.

options.title: Document Current Behavior Only
options.body: Update TUI docs and /help with Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, and backslash-Enter fallback details while keeping Enter-to-send as the fixed default.

options.title: Add Narrow Keybinding Preference
options.body: Expose a small TUI-only keybinding preference with tests for Enter/newline/send behavior, docs, and upgrade-safe defaults.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Composer UX
options.body: Defer the configurable shortcut choice behind the broader WebChat/TUI composer shortcut and long-prompt product cluster.

recommendation.title: Document Current Behavior Only
recommendation.body: Update TUI docs and /help with Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, and backslash-Enter fallback details while keeping Enter-to-send as the fixed default.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter already scoped the item to docs/help plus product decision and has recent adjacent TUI docs history.
